validity_rules: Use the full public test split unless LIMIT is explicitly documented as a smoke test.
Generate exactly one completion per sample for Pass@1 and exact match evidence.
Do not repair HumanEval outputs using benchmark test failures.
Keep per-sample predictions under reports/ for auditability.
Treat vendor or leaderboard numbers as candidate selection only until this harness reruns them.
